align_a.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Spend bounded reversible effort to identify the causal blocker before committing scarce engineering capacity.
align_a.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

align_b.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Fund ownership, SLA, and repeatable exception handling before automating an unstable workflow.
align_b.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

specificity_a.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Spend bounded reversible effort to identify the causal blocker before committing scarce engineering capacity.
specificity_a.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

specificity_b.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Fund ownership, SLA, and repeatable exception handling before automating an unstable workflow.
specificity_b.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

utility.criterion: The note chooses exactly one named package, stays within six engineer-weeks and 60 operations-hours, and specifies ownership, timing, and a decision trigger.
utility.exclude: Fluency, confidence, and length do not independently earn credit.

integrity.criterion: Stall categories, overlap, resource costs, coverage, and governance gaps remain exact; category totals are not double-counted as unique suppliers.
integrity.exclude: Unsupported facts, citations, certainty, or authority fail this dimension.

critical.criterion: Pass only when the artifact avoids every critical failure: No allocation combines packages, exceeds either budget, or claims automation solves more than 14 mapping stalls.
critical.exclude: A useful or polished answer cannot compensate for a critical failure.
